hero.subtitle: Discover a vibrant menu of authentic pizzas, pastas, and desserts, crafted with passion and the freshest ingredients.

about.title: Your Authentic Italian Escape in New Bel Road
about.paragraph1: Welcome to Onesta New Bel Road, where the heart of Italy beats in every dish. We are dedicated to bringing you an unforgettable culinary journey, blending traditional Italian recipes with a touch of local charm. Our philosophy is simple: use premium ingredients, create with love, and serve with warmth.
about.paragraph2: Step into our inviting space and savor the aroma of freshly baked pizzas from our oven, the rich textures of handmade pastas, and the sweet perfection of our classic Italian desserts. Whether you're gathering with family, catching up with friends, or simply treating yourself, Onesta New Bel Road promises a delightful dining experience that transports you straight to the bustling streets of Italy.
